name: Astral Knot Garment
summary: Wynne Larson works fine spider silk into a garment in Stormwind City. An adventurer brings her rare silk gathered from the wilds, and she tailors it into a magical weave for dangerous journeys and high-society gatherings.

sections.title: A Weaver's Wit
sections.body: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, tailors serve arcane elites and visiting nobles. Wynne Larson is known for weaving pristine spider silk into durable, enchanted garments. Her playful humor comes through when she jokes about saving a few precious scraps for her own wardrobe before handing over her finished work.

sections.title: Versatile Elegance
sections.body: Spellcasters who wear cloth prize the Astral Knot Garment for its resilience and refinement. Its silk comes from dangerous spiders, and its weave is made to endure combat while keeping the polished look expected at formal banquets in Stormwind Keep.

faq.q: What is the Astral Knot Garment?
faq.answer: Wynne Larson crafts the Astral Knot Garment in Stormwind City from pristine spider silk. It is made for cloth-wearing practitioners facing combat or attending high-society affairs.

faq.q: Who crafts the Astral Knot Garment?
faq.answer: Wynne Larson, a tailor in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, crafts the garment when given the needed exotic materials.

faq.q: What materials are required to complete this garment?
faq.answer: The garment requires pristine spider silk gathered from deadly spiders in the wild regions of the world. Tailoring preserves the silk's natural strength and enchantability.

faq.q: Why does Wynne Larson tease about keeping leftover silk?
faq.answer: Wynne jokes about making the garment short so she can keep a few scraps of the rare, prized spider silk. She delivers the finished work in full.

faq.q: Where in Stormwind does this tailoring take place?
aliases: where to turn in astral knot
faq.answer: The tailoring takes place in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, a district of scholars, arcanists, and clothiers skilled in enchanted textiles.

faq.q: Who typically wears the Astral Knot Garment?
faq.answer: Alliance mages favor the Astral Knot Garment for its light, protective weave and dignified appearance.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Stormwind's arcane dignity in this garment, with practical enchantments for travel beyond the kingdom's fortified walls.
Wynne Larson's work shows how pristine spider silk can be refined into grand fashion.
As an Alliance champion, you can find Stormwind craftsmanship suited to royal halls and dangerous frontlines alike.
